comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 flags comments that supply specific factual data or verifiable citations (statistics, links, named sources). It excludes vague appeals, opinions and hypotheticals. Feature 1 flags comments that use abstract reasoning (general principles, logic, conceptual argument) not grounded in personal experience. Evidence-based specifics and abstract argument are different predicates, and a comment can satisfy one and not the other. The shared source, binary output and any-comment aggregation do not make them equivalent.
